findings.summary: New flags with no linked issue; feature already achievable with a small script piped into rg -F -f -, so it doesn't belong in core
Two mutually exclusive switches (--base64/--base64url) where repo prefers one flag; collapse to one
-i/--smart-case silently defeat the fixed-strings implication and match wrongly
Tests don't exercise HiArgs wiring; no end-to-end rgtest
Docs describe a regex mechanism the code doesn't use
Machine-written-looking docs, em dashes, overlong line
Body's stated reason for not reusing the encoder is wrong
Lean: drop the whole PR in favor of script
Lean: drop --base64url, Base64Mode enum, redundant tests and comments

why: Finding 1 says the feature already composes via a short script piped into rg -F -f - and shouldn't be carried as permanent flags, which matches 'use a wrapper script'.
